projection.name: arangodb
projection.title: ArangoDB
projection.description: Multi-model ArangoDB cockpit: databases, collections, document CRUD, AQL console, named-graph explorer, ArangoSearch views, analyzers, Foxx services, and cluster/shard health.

fields.label: Coordinator endpoint
fields.help: Base URL of a single server or cluster coordinator.

validators.message: most characters are allowed; not / : % ? # + or control characters

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable database credential. Its username field is used when present.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks every mutating route and any AQL containing INSERT, UPDATE, REPLACE, UPSERT or REMOVE.

fields.label: Confirm writing AQL
fields.help: Requires an explicit confirmation before data-modifying AQL executes.

fields.label: Graph expand depth
fields.help: Hops fetched when seeding or expanding the graph explorer.

fields.label: Redacted attributes
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for document attributes and result columns that must be masked.

config.label: AQL
config.emptyText: Run AQL to see results. Prefix a query with EXPLAIN to inspect its execution plan instead.
config.initialQuery:
FOR c IN COLLECTIONS()
  FILTER !STARTS_WITH(c.name, "_")
  SORT c.name
  LIMIT 25
  RETURN { collection: c.name, documents: COLLECTION_COUNT(c.name) }

actions.label: Uninstall service
actions.confirmText: Uninstall this Foxx service and run its teardown script. Collections it created may be removed.

actions.label: Kill query
actions.confirmText: Kill this running AQL query. Partial writes from a modifying query are rolled back.
